title: Photograph of two dark objects in sky beside treeline, with original print (Inc 3)
description: Enlarged photographic print of a pale sky with dark foliage along the upper right edge, showing a dark elongated object near the bottom left and another dark shape at top left with a thin line extending across the frame. A small original print is mounted at lower right. Handwritten "Inc 3" at lower left; stamped CONFIDENTIAL.
